description: This source file defines the implementation of navigation categories for a calculator application, including category initialization, mode support checks, serialization, and user-specific configurations.

classes.name: NavCategory
classes.description: Represents a navigation category within the calculator app, including properties like name, icon, view mode, and support for negative values.

classes.name: NavCategoryGroup
classes.description: Represents a group of navigation categories, typically used for organizing categories in the UI.

classes.name: NavCategoryStates
classes.description: Manages the state of navigation categories, including creation of menu options, serialization, deserialization, and user-specific settings.

methods.name: IsCalculatorViewMode
methods.description: Checks if a given view mode is a calculator mode (Standard, Scientific, Programmer).

methods.name: IsGraphingCalculatorViewMode
methods.description: Checks if a given view mode is the Graphing calculator mode.

methods.name: IsDateCalculatorViewMode
methods.description: Checks if a given view mode is the Date calculator mode.

methods.name: IsConverterViewMode
methods.description: Checks if a given view mode is a converter mode.

methods.name: IsModeInCategoryGroup
methods.description: Determines if a view mode belongs to a specific category group.

methods.name: SetCurrentUser
methods.description: Sets the current user ID for user-specific category state management.

methods.name: CreateMenuOptions
methods.description: Creates and returns the menu options for calculator and converter categories.

methods.name: CreateCalculatorCategoryGroup
methods.description: Creates a category group for calculator modes.

methods.name: CreateConverterCategoryGroup
methods.description: Creates a category group for converter modes.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes a view mode into an integer for storage.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Restores a view mode from a stored object.

methods.name: GetViewModeForFriendlyName
methods.description: Retrieves the view mode corresponding to a friendly name string.

methods.name: GetFriendlyName
methods.description: Gets the friendly name string for a given view mode.

methods.name: GetNameResourceKey
methods.description: Gets the resource key for the name of a view mode.

methods.name: GetGroupType
methods.description: Returns the category group type for a given view mode.

methods.name: GetIndex
methods.description: Returns the 0-based index of a view mode in the category list.

methods.name: GetFlatIndex
methods.description: Returns the flat index of a view mode across all categories.

methods.name: GetIndexInGroup
methods.description: Returns the index of a view mode within a specific category group.

methods.name: GetPosition
methods.description: Returns the 1-based position of a view mode in the category list.

methods.name: GetViewModeForVirtualKey
methods.description: Returns the view mode associated with a virtual key.

methods.name: GetCategoryAcceleratorKeys
methods.description: Populates a list with accelerator keys for categories.

methods.name: IsValidViewMode
methods.description: Checks if a view mode is valid.

methods.name: IsViewModeEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a view mode is enabled, considering graphing mode support.
